usedFor: Teamgate captures new leads, and Sangam CRM keeps them when “New Lead Created” runs “Create or Update Lead”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Lead Created” in Teamgate, then “Create or Update Lead” in Sangam CRM
bestTemplate.why: Leads from Teamgate reach Sangam CRM, matched by ID, email or phone, so one person stays one lead.

watchOut: “New Lead Created” in Teamgate is polling, so leads reach Sangam CRM after a scheduled check.
